people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.
translations.bsb: Jesus said to him, “Today salvation has come to this house, because this man too is a son of Abraham.
translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
translations.asv: And Jesus said unto him, To-day is salvation come to this house, forasmuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
